verdict.rationale: Synthesia publishes a public API reference and quickstart. It covers a Video API for scripted avatar videos, translation and templates, plus Upload, Billing and Localization APIs. Jobs run asynchronously with polling or webhooks and return a downloadable .mp4, and a probe confirmed a live docs llms.txt describing the API. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the API working in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Video API — generate finished video files: scripted avatar videos, dubbing, translation, and templates at scale.
Asynchronous — you submit a job and poll or get a webhook when it's ready.
Upload API (V2) — upload your own image/video assets or custom script audio (e.g. your own text-to-speech) for use when creating Video API videos.
Billing API — retrieve your workspace's current billing period and credit balance programmatically.
Localization API — localize your videos into up to 20 languages per request.
the response includes then a time-limited download link in the `download` attribute, use this link to download the video as an `.mp4`
